title: What can that claw do?
hook: A body part can be used in more than one way.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The diagram shows a male fiddler crab with one enlarged claw and a raised-claw display. Such displays can communicate to other crabs; the drawing does not establish a specific recipient or behavioral outcome.

misconception: A large claw can only be used for catching food.
objective: In this illustrated male fiddler crab, what action is shown with the enlarged claw?
